# ClickRunClaw

> EU-first AI automation studio. We build custom AI agents for sales triage, customer support, invoice reconciliation and back-office workflows, then run them on dedicated German and Finnish infrastructure. Fixed price, written delivery, no meetings.

## What we do

- **Single workflow agent** ($799 setup, $149/month): one production agent for support or sales triage, one channel, CRM or sheet sync, live in seven days.
- **Revenue pipeline** ($1,799 setup, $299/month): multi-step inbound pipeline with enrichment, scoring, routing, a conversion landing page and server-side tracking.
- **Operations fleet** ($3,499+ setup, $599/month): multi-agent document extraction and reconciliation with ERP sync and human review gates.

## How delivery works

Day 0: written brief. Day 1: architecture and fixed price. Day 4: staging sandbox. Day 7: production handover on client-owned EU infrastructure. No discovery calls, no video meetings, every decision in writing.

## Facts

- Infrastructure: dedicated containers in Frankfurt, Germany and Helsinki, Finland.
- Data: no client data is used to train models. Optional Mistral EU inference for residency-sensitive work.
- Ownership: code, prompts and infrastructure config transfer to the client on handover.
- Contact: support@clickrunclaw.com
- Studio: CryptoWebBuild (https://cryptowebbuild.com)
